item.title: Prosecution to submit Tengku Zafrul’s statement in Muhyiddin case
item.description: The prosecution is preparing the witness statement of former finance minister Tengku Zafrul for Muhyiddin Yassin's trial, with 99.5% of statements already handed to the defence

item.title: Malaysia allocates RM137 million to combat rising NCD threat
item.description: Health Ministry channels funds into screening and treatment as diabetes and heart disease complications strain the national healthcare system

item.title: MAE proposes rehiring retirees to fix Malaysia teacher gap
item.description: MAE urges Malaysia to rehire retired teachers ahead of 2027 Year 1 expansion for six-year-olds

item.title: Malaysia’s labour productivity grows 4.9% in Q4 2025
item.description: Labour productivity per hour worked rose to RM46.3 in Q4 2025, driven by strong economic growth and gains across all major economic sectors

item.title: HRD Corp restructuring and governance upgrade set for March completion
item.description: HRD Corp's restructuring and governance enhancement is on track for completion by late March, says Human Resources Minister R. Ramanan

item.title: The refreshed 2026 Proton S70 is open for bookings at showrooms
item.description: It is no secret that a major refresh for the 2026 Proton S70 was in the works and now it is has officially arrived at all 3S/4S showrooms nationwide with bookings being accepted from Feb 7 onwards. Gone is the three-banger, replaced with the new four-cylinder turbocharged i-GT 1.5-litre engine that first debuted in the Proton X50. It is mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Outputs are 181 PS and 290 Nm of torque over the outgoing engines 150 PS and 226 Nm.

item.title: Venezuelan political prisoners launch hunger strike over amnesty exclusions
item.description: Over 200 political prisoners in Venezuela are on hunger strike, demanding release under a new amnesty law that excludes many military and terrorism-related cases.

item.title: Singapore sees record 245 million travellers in 2025
item.description: Singapore's checkpoints processed a record 245 million travellers in 2025, a 6.3% increase driven by new clearance systems and a surge in vehicle traffic.

item.title: Keeper security expands relationship with ingram micro to broaden availability of privileged access management in singapore
item.description: Keeper Security is expanding its partnership with Ingram Micro to make its zero-trust KeeperPAM platform more accessible in Singapore. The move supports organisations in enhancing privileged access security, improving compliance and defending against increasingly sophisticated cyber threats.

item.title: Terengganu exco member to face MACC charges tomorrow
item.description: A Terengganu exco member arrested by MACC over alleged abuse of power is set to be charged in court tomorrow
